title: Integrate European tilemap geometry
changes: Publish six separately rooted tilemap geometry groups as graphics.tilemap-geometry in EUR e162-d161, retaining the two physical copies and original unbounded guest indexing.
Serve the 48 source bytes through typed ROM reads with mixed-owner and raw fallback composition.
validation: Wine source disassembly i36cx5vz, vl8mhv5l and _9loiqbv establishes the two original readers, six roots and five observed direct constructor call sites with index zero.

Windows GNU test build wbix4esr and Wine 5zpi8vam passed creation/reuse, all 104 previous resource files unchanged, all 48 poisoned source bytes, boundaries, guards and 24 original-reader state/clock cases through interpreter and generated dispatch.
Production Windows build ws_q09i1 and Wine CLI j4r9sopl passed creation, reuse and verification of all 106 matching files; an 11-frame world-map window read no tilemap geometry bytes.
limitations: Generated dispatch may fall back to interpretation. Ordinary use, other readers, global index domains, broader Wine regressions, Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance measurements.
